purpose: Suggest two representative options for taking action.
keywords: N / V dictionary + なり … + なり
Contact me, whether by calling or emailing.
Let’s rest with some water or tea.
Check it by using a dictionary or asking someone.
formation: N / V dictionary + なり … + なり
restrictions: Alternatives are examples; other suitable choices may exist.
mistake: Do not read the pair as requiring both actions.
